desc:
SKILL ISSUE WARNING ⚠️❗

Welcome to Project MX, the ultimate motocross experience. Whether tearing up various enduro trails, tossing fat whips at Slayground, or riding on the many supercross or motocross tracks, this game has something for every rider.

Explore stunning landscapes, forests, and a vast desert full of hidden jumps and challenging sx and mx tracks. Traverse the rough terrain, master insane whips, and race on tracks built for speed and precision.

With freestyle, enduro, and racing, Project MX delivers the perfect blend of off-road thrills and breathtaking scenery.

- This experience is best played with Controller! 
- Mobile Supported
